name: Smart Video Scheduler
intro: Smart Video Scheduler is an early preview of a content calendar page, showing where scheduling and performance tracking are planned to live.

features.calendar-tab: The Calendar tab is open when the page loads. It marks the spot where your scheduled posts will appear.
features.schedule-tab: The Schedule tab previews the area where you'll plan your content for the best posting times.
features.analytics-tab: The Analytics tab previews the area where you'll track how your posts perform across platforms.

outro: That's the preview. For now, publish from the studio where you made your video, and check back as scheduling grows.
